overlay_changes.note: Windows-only platform patch: blank import of time/tzdata. Without it startup aborts on Windows and every API returns 404 while the UI still loads. Still absent upstream as of 0.2.16, so it remains required.

Adds gemini-4-argon (and its -gcp alias) to the hardcoded fallback price table plus a Contains-based matcher. NEW as of 2026-10-14. Upstream edits this file frequently - if a conflict lands here, keep BOTH sides: their new entries and ours. Our hunks are additive (one price struct, one if-branch).

how_to_price_a_new_model: 1. The runtime price source is a LiteLLM-format catalog, not a DB table: data_dir/model_prices_and_context_window.json, refreshed from pricing.remote_url.
2. Precedence when resolving a model: group.model_pricing -> channel_model_pricing -> LiteLLM catalog -> hardcoded fallback in billing_service.go.
3. Nothing strips model-name suffixes, so an alias like 'gemini-4-argon-gcp' needs its own resolution - either its own catalog key or a Contains-based matcher in the fallback.
4. Editing data_dir/model_prices_and_context_window.json is futile: the 10-minute sync job overwrites it. Use pricing.override_file (highest precedence, never overwritten) for a no-code fix.
5. Historical usage_logs keep the cost computed at the time - fixing a price does NOT rewrite past records.
